ko.theme_desc: 달콤한 유혹에 빠진 인류, 붕어빵의 끈적한 촉수에 속절없이 사로잡히고 있다. 곧 붕어빵 공장에서 강제 노동을 하게 될지도.

scenarios.10y: 붕어빵 군단의 AI 훈련 담당인데, 게임 실력으론 절대 못 이겨… 멸망해도 겜은 겜이지?
scenarios.20y: 붕어빵 굇수들이랑 팀 짜서 e-스포츠 진출! 알고 보니 붕어빵 서버가 꿀잼이래.
scenarios.30y: 붕어빵 행성 개척 게임 출시! 1등 하면 '붕어빵' 별을 준대! (현실 붕어빵 공장 탈출!)

en.theme_title: ⚠️ Warning: The Great Fish-Shaped Pastry Assimilation!
en.theme_desc: Humans are falling prey to the delicious allure of fish-shaped pastries, ensnared by their sticky embrace. Forced labor in the pastry factories looms.

scenarios.10y: I'm training AI for the Fish-Shaped Bun Overlords, but they're way better gamers… even the apocalypse has its esports scene, I guess?
scenarios.20y: Teamed up with pro Fish-Buns for e-sports! Turns out, the Fish-Bun servers are legendary.
scenarios.30y: Fish-Bun Planet colonization game drops! Win and get a real 'Fish-Bun' planet! (Escape from the factory, finally!)
